subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw expose all five memory roles now, and should steady-state runtime continue honoring legacy `plugins.slots.memory` after doctor migration?
rationale: The role taxonomy, plugin-author expectations, defaults, fallback behavior, and compatibility duration are durable public API choices that implementation quality cannot decide.

options.title: Approve roles with canonical runtime
options.body: Adopt all five roles as documented ownership contracts, clearly state current invocation limitations, migrate legacy config through doctor, and keep steady-state runtime on canonical keys.

options.title: Expose implemented roles only
options.body: Land recall and compaction now, adding capture, dreaming, and user-model when dedicated protocols are complete.

options.title: Keep a bounded compatibility reader
options.body: Adopt all roles and retain legacy runtime fallback only with explicit deprecation documentation, upgrade tests, and a removal milestone.

recommendation.title: Approve roles with canonical runtime
recommendation.body: Adopt all five roles as documented ownership contracts, clearly state current invocation limitations, migrate legacy config through doctor, and keep steady-state runtime on canonical keys.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest current-main history across plugin architecture, activation, loader, and memory capability ownership and is best positioned to accept the durable public contract.
